q: How does Fuel count in this week's hours?
options: Kiosk and walk-in are both set at every store
Once: you set the kiosk or the walk-in, whichever your store has
Fuel is not part of this week
explain: Fuel is 2 hours and counts once. A store has a kiosk or a walk-in, and you set the one you have.

q: After the Snack Nuts reset, where do the Our Brand canisters live?
explain: The canisters come off shelf 4 and stay on shelves 2 and 3. Shelf 4 goes to new items.

q: How is trail mix organized in the new Snack Nuts flow?
options: One horizontal row on the top shelf
Two vertical ribbons: mainstream, and Natural trail mix and nuts
explain: Trail mix runs in two vertical ribbons, and multipacks sit toward the bottom of their ribbon.

q: What is the action item on the new Packaged Bulk strips?
options: Check every strip image against the product in front of it
Hold the strips for the store to install
Install only the car cup strips
explain: The last update went up with wrong images that stayed up. Check every image, and if one is wrong, let your supervisor know right away.

q: The KIND brand stays in the Packaged Bulk set after this reflow.
explain: KIND exits the set. The remaining product lines up by type.

q: Where do the two new car cup items go?
options: In the main Packaged Bulk set
On the checklane car cup racks only
explain: The two new items are for the checklane car cup racks only.

q: If the store is busy, Kompass can carry the new items out to the fuel center.
explain: Kompass does not carry product between the store and the fuel center in either direction. Store management gets the new items out there.

q: On the kiosk window wrap-around racks, where do lighters go?
options: Always on the right, standing outside facing the kiosk
explain: The racks are set customer-facing, left to right, and lighters are always on the right when you face the kiosk from outside.

q: What changes on Wild Bird Seed besides the items?
options: The planogram moves from department 01 to department 03
It moves to the fuel center
explain: The planogram moves from department 01 to department 03, with full strips.

q: Where do you get the planograms for the Specialty Bath peg sets?
options: In this week's Dump Bin, in the Specialty Bath Peg POGs folder
There are none; skip the peg sets
explain: The peg planograms were not ordered with the strips. They are in this week's Dump Bin, one file per store. Do not skip the peg sets.

q: Which of these are the Specialty Bath peg sets? Pick all that apply.
explain: Earth Therapeutics, the face masks and the Miss Spa panel are the peg sets. Foot Care is its own maintenance.

q: An item with a code change gets pulled as discontinued.
explain: A change is not a delete. Same product, new code, and it stays on the shelf. Check before you pull.

q: On Specialty Cheese, where do the olives come off?
options: The two-shelf ambient olive rack only
explain: Olives come off the two-shelf ambient olive rack only and stay on every other cheese planogram.

q: What should you expect on the Yogurt test set? Pick all that apply.
options: A 20-minute limit on product out of the case
explain: The test uses store-specific planograms with a reflow, shelf moves and slight shelf height changes, and it is a cold set.

q: Strips arrive to add Kitchen Bouquet back to Dry Sauce and Gravy. Who installs them?
explain: It is not a Kompass event. Store associates install those strips. Confirm the store knows.

q: A shadow box set is on your list and the store no longer has it. What do you do? Pick all that apply.
options: Put the reason in the comment bubble
Call it out in your EOD notes
explain: All three, every time. Skip one and the set comes right back.

q: What is the biggest set in P12W1?
explain: Yogurt is 8 of the 20 hours in P12W1, and it runs cold.
